name: text-computing
description: Workspace for deterministic text computing packages.

scripts.build: npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textfacts run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textdoc run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpack run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpack-language-registry run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpack-unicode-17 run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpack-cldr-core run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpack-ar-msa-morphology run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpack-en-syntax-ud-gumreddit run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpack-wordnet-en run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpack-foundation run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textlex run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textfst run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textrules run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textnorm run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textclassical run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpipeline run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textdata run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textcorpus run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textsearch run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textkb run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textquality run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textparallel run -s build
scripts.lint: npm run --workspaces --if-present lint && npm run -s check:boundaries && npm run -s check:public-language
scripts.schema:validate: node tools/validate-repo-schemas.mjs && node tools/validate-textpack-packages.mjs && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textfacts run schema:validate
